section_title: Apex National Bank - Retail Personal Loan Policy
text:
Apex National Bank - Retail Personal Loan Policy
Document ID: POL-2023-01 | Effective Date: 2023-04-01

Section 1: Scope and Definitions
This master policy governs all retail unsecured personal loans issued by Apex National Bank across India starting April 1, 2023. All branches must strictly adhere to the eligibility criteria, interest schedules, and penalty clauses specified below.

Clause 3.1: Applicant Eligibility
To qualify for a Retail Personal Loan, the primary applicant must be a resident Indian citizen with a minimum age of 21 years at the time of application and a maximum age of 60 years at loan maturity. The applicant must have a minimum net monthly income of INR 30,000.

Clause 4.2: Base Interest Rate
The standard annual interest rate applicable on all approved Retail Personal Loans shall be 9.50% per annum on a reducing balance basis.

Clause 5.1: Late Payment Penalty
If an EMI remains unpaid beyond the 5-day grace period from the due date, a late payment penalty of 2.0% per month shall be levied on the overdue EMI amount.

section_title: Clause 6.1: Loan Amount and Repayment Tenure
text:
Clause 6.1: Loan Amount and Repayment Tenure
Eligible applicants may borrow between INR 50,000 and INR 15,00,000. The maximum repayment tenure allowed under this policy is 60 months from the date of disbursement.

section_title: Subject: Revision of Interest Rate and Late Payment Penalty
text:
Subject: Revision of Interest Rate and Late Payment Penalty
Pursuant to revised funding costs, this circular formally amends Document ID POL-2023-01 (Retail Personal Loan Policy dated 2023-04-01) with effect from April 1, 2024.
Amendment to Clause 4.2 (Base Interest Rate)

section_title: Clause 4.2 of POL-2023-01 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2024, the standard annual interest rate applicable on all Retail Personal Loans is revised from 9.50% per annum to 10.50% per annum on a reducing balance basis.
text: Clause 4.2 of POL-2023-01 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2024, the standard annual interest rate applicable on all Retail Personal Loans is revised from 9.50% per annum to 10.50% per annum on a reducing balance basis.
Amendment to Clause 5.1 (Late Payment Penalty)

section_title: Clause 5.1 of POL-2023-01 is hereby superseded. Effective April 1, 2024, the late payment penalty for overdue EMIs beyond the 5-day grace period is increased from 2.0% per month to 3.0% per month on the overdue EMI amount.

section_title: Apex National Bank - Digital Sourcing Partner
text: Apex National Bank - Digital Sourcing Partner

Addendum
Document ID: ADD-2025-03 | Effective Date: 2025-05-01

Section 1: Digital Loan Origination Terms
This addendum defines operational guidelines for Retail Personal Loans sourced through authorized digital lending partners.

Clause 2.1: Borrower Age Requirement
Every applicant applying for a Retail Personal Loan must have a minimum age of 25 years at the time of application. Applications from individuals below 25 years shall be rejected.

Clause 2.2: Maximum Loan Repayment Tenure
The maximum repayment tenure permitted for any Retail Personal Loan shall not exceed 48 months from the date of disbursement.
